entities.name: Paging for EPS services
entities.description: Procedure used by the network to page a UE for EPS services when the UE is in idle mode.

entities.name: PAGING message
entities.description: Message sent by the network to page a UE for EPS services.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE state
entities.description: UE state where the UE is not registered with the network and may be paged.

relations.description: The paging procedure involves sending a PAGING message to the UE.
Paging procedure is performed when the UE is in EMM-IDLE state.
